archive_scope: Normal source packages reconstructed. Cargo.toml.orig and the generated gettext timestamp account for distribution clean/build differences.

runtime.application_stack: Final release packages on the ROG. Loaded libraries verified in the application process.
runtime.paused_dolby: A controlled private GNOME compositor supplied 616, 308 and 616 cd/m². The video changed then returned byte for byte at an unchanged timestamp. Subtitle composition order, rectangles, global alpha, and displayed pixels passed for adding, replacing and removing overlays.
runtime.unavailable_composition: An explicit supplemental context withdrew composition. The sink cleared its picture and restored it and the overlays when the real target returned.
runtime.ordinary_control: Ordinary paused video and subtitles stayed identical on the normal packaged nativehdr15 compositor. Its virtual output supplied an SDR surface; the 616/308 control used a separate instrumented compositor.
runtime.physical_panel: A session using the installed release and an optical measurement are separate acceptance steps.

build_scope: Initial panel package source comparison. The final SDK rebuild and actual product checks follow below.

sdk_rebuild.paused_product_controls: Real 616/308/616 target changes with overlay add, replace and remove plus ordinary-video control passed on the rebuilt packages.
